prd: $RALPH_PRIVATE_PRD (private repo, READ ONLY: never copy its private sections into this public repo)
description: Wave 2 of the investor portal, stacked on wave 1: editable overview/team/FAQ/contact sections, the video player, per-document analytics with page drop-off, CSV export, the privacy-policy section and the footer link.

decisions.text: FILES. A story may create or change ONLY: investors/** (the React app), server/investors/** (the API, NEW numbered SQL migrations (never edit an applied one) and tests), privacy.html (ONE new section, W2-08), _footer.js (ONE new link, W2-08), README.md (the 'Investor portal' section), package.json and package-lock.json of investors/ (KP2), .github/workflows/investors.yml (only to add specs to the e2e job if needed), and this kit's files under scripts/ralph/. server.js, Dockerfile, the root package.json and every other public page or asset of the site stay byte-identical to the wave-1 base (the gate diffs them).

DEPENDENCIES: only these, each installed with 'npm install --save-exact --ignore-scripts <name>@<major>' (or the exact version given) and recorded in the DONE note. ROOT packages: no change in this wave (wave 1 set them). investors/ dependencies: react@18, react-dom@18, react-router-dom@6, @tanstack/react-query@5, @clerk/clerk-react@5, react-pdf@9, pdfjs-dist (exactly the version react-pdf@9 depends on, 4.8.69), recharts@2, lucide-react@0, class-variance-authority@0.7, clsx@2, tailwind-merge@2 (NOT 3: v3 is Tailwind 4 only), tailwindcss-animate@1, sonner@2, zod@3, react-markdown@9, any @radix-ui/react-* package. investors/ devDependencies: vite@6, @vitejs/plugin-react@4, typescript@5, tailwindcss@3, postcss@8, autoprefixer@10, eslint@9, @eslint/js@9, typescript-eslint@8, eslint-plugin-react-hooks@5, eslint-plugin-react-refresh@0, globals, vitest@3, jsdom@26, @testing-library/react@16, @testing-library/jest-dom@6, @types/react@18, @types/react-dom@18, @types/node@22, @playwright/test@1.64.1 (exact). Anything else: RALPH_BLOCKED with the reason. The gate enforces the list and the majors.

SERVER-SIDE ENFORCEMENT. Every /api/investors route except GET /api/investors/health goes through the auth middleware; identity (clerk user id, email, investor id) comes ONLY from the verified Clerk token, never from a body, query, header other than Authorization, or cookie; admin = the token's Clerk user id is in INVESTOR_ADMIN_CLERK_IDS (comma-separated), checked on the server for every /admin route. A blocked investor gets 403 on every investor route. Unpublished documents are 404 to investors. A test enumerates the router stack and fails if any route other than /health lacks the middleware.

NEVER BREAK THE SITE. The portal is optional. Missing config (INVESTORS_DATABASE_URL, CLERK_SECRET_KEY, CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, or the S3 variables for document routes) or a failed migration puts the portal in 'disabled' with a logged reason: /api/investors/* answers 503 {error:'portal_unavailable'} and /investors serves the app, which shows 'The investor portal is temporarily unavailable' and the contact link. Every other route of automatos.app behaves exactly as on the base. Startup never throws because of the portal; migrations run in the background after app.listen and the portal answers 503 'starting' until they finish.

PUBLIC REPO. This repository is public. Never commit: env files (the secrets hook blocks *.env and *.env.* paths: document variable NAMES in README.md instead, never an .env.example), keys or tokens (sk_live_, sk_test_ with a real value, pk_live_, AKIA..., private keys), real documents, real investor names or emails, the names of the site's admins, or text from the private PRD's content plan or open questions. Test fixtures are invented (investor 'Ada Example' at 'Example Ventures', ada@example.com) and tiny (a generated one- or two-page PDF under 20 kB). No vendor branding from the reference portal (KP12).

LOCAL CHECKS ARE PURE NODE. Allowed on this machine: npm ci/install (KP2 rules), tsc, eslint, vitest (jsdom and PGlite run in-process), vite build, node --check, reading node_modules. NEVER on this machine: node server.js, vite dev, vite preview, any server or listening socket, Playwright, a browser, docker, gh workflow run, git push, opening a PR, git merge. Playwright and the docker build run in CI only (W1-05, W1-19).

TEST DATABASE. Server code talks to Postgres only through server/investors/db.js: createDb({connectionString}) over pg.Pool (max 5, idleTimeoutMillis 30000) exposing query(text, params) and tx(fn). Tests use the same interface over PGlite (@electric-sql/pglite, real Postgres in-process) via server/investors/__tests__/helpers/test-db.js, or over pg when INVESTORS_TEST_DATABASE_URL is set (CI's Postgres service). Every SQL statement is parameterized ($1..$n) and schema-qualified (investors.<table>); no string-built SQL with request data.

MIGRATIONS (deviation from the PRD's node-pg-migrate, so tests run on PGlite): numbered plain SQL files server/investors/migrations/NNN_name.sql, applied in order by server/investors/migrate.js. The runner: creates schema 'investors' only when pg_namespace lacks it (in production the schema already exists, owned by the portal's role), creates investors.schema_migrations(name text primary key, applied_at timestamptz default now()), then applies each missing file in its own transaction after SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(724001) and records it. Re-running is a no-op. A failed file rolls back and disables the portal (KP4).

CLERK. App: @clerk/clerk-react@5 <ClerkProvider publishableKey={window.AUTOMATOS_CONFIG.clerkPublishableKey}> (runtime config, hydrated by server.js from CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY; never a build-time env). API calls send 'Authorization: Bearer <await getToken()>'. Server: @clerk/backend verifyToken(token, {secretKey, authorizedParties}) with authorizedParties from INVESTORS_AUTHORIZED_PARTIES (comma-separated, default 'https://automatos.app'), behind an injectable verifier (academy server/spine/auth.js pattern) so tests use a fake. Investor email and name come from the Clerk user (createClerkClient({secretKey}).users.getUser, cached per process for 10 minutes) on first sight; later requests read the row. NO cookie auth anywhere (stricter than the PRD): the pagehide flush uses fetch(..., {keepalive: true}) with the last cached token.

E2E FAKE AUTH SEAM. investors/src/auth/ has ONE module that wraps Clerk (useAuthState, SignedInGate, AccountMenu, getToken). When import.meta.env.VITE_INVESTORS_E2E === '1' (set ONLY by the e2e build script) it swaps to a fake provider whose code contains the marker string 'INVESTORS_E2E_FAKE_AUTH'. The production build (npm run build) must not contain that marker (vite dead-code-eliminates the branch; the gate greps investors/dist). The server has no fake verifier outside tests.

S3. server/investors/s3.js (pattern: academy server/media/s3.js, lazy S3Client) with an injectable client; env INVESTOR_DOCS_BUCKET, INVESTOR_DOCS_REGION, INVESTOR_DOCS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, INVESTOR_DOCS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY. Keys: documents/<documentId>/v<version>/<safeFileName> (safeFileName: [A-Za-z0-9._-] only, max 120 chars). Presigned PUT 15 minutes with ContentType fixed; presigned GET 5 minutes with ResponseContentDisposition (inline or attachment; filename*=UTF-8 encoded). Allowed content types: application/pdf, video/mp4, text/csv, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document. Max 262144000 bytes (250 MB). Never log a presigned URL.

REFERENCE PORTAL (READ ONLY, never edit): the folder named by $RALPH_REFERENCE_PORTAL (set by the launcher; never write that path or the portal's name into this repo). Port its UI: src/components/ui/* (only the components a story uses), components.json, src/pages/Dashboard.tsx + src/components/investor/InvestorSidebar.tsx + InvestorHero.tsx (shell), src/components/investor/sections/DataRoom.tsx (library), src/components/marketplace/CoaPdfViewer.tsx (viewer), src/components/admin/AnalyticsManager.tsx (overview, table, timeline), src/components/admin/DocumentManager.tsx (upload UI), src/lib/activityTracker.ts (heartbeat idea), src/lib/csvExport.ts. Strip ALL of: its brand names, copy, colours, fonts, domains, tiers, wallet/NFT, NDA, CRM, Supabase client and calls, Lovable code. Its data-access and permission code is never ported: every data call goes to this kit's API.

LOOK. The app looks like automatos.app: fonts Geist (sans), Instrument Serif (headings), Geist Mono (labels) from the same Google Fonts URL the site uses; colours as CSS variables mapped from the site's two moods: bone (--bg #F2EDE4, --bg-2 #ECE6DA, --fg #0F1411, --fg-2 #2C3531, --muted #6E6960, --rule-c rgba(15,20,17,0.14), --accent oklch(0.45 0.06 155), --accent-ink #F2EDE4) and pitch (--bg #0E1311, --bg-2 #161C19, --fg #EFE9DD, --fg-2 #C9C2B4, --muted #8A857C, --rule-c rgba(239,233,221,0.14), --accent oklch(0.78 0.10 95), --accent-ink #0E1311). The mood follows the site: localStorage 'automatos-mood' ('bone'|'pitch'), else prefers-color-scheme; set as data-mood on <body>; Tailwind darkMode ['class'] is NOT used: shadcn tokens read the CSS variables. Square-ish corners (radius 2px), thin rules, no gradients, no glow. Phone first: every investor page works at 390 px.

COPY. Calm and factual; no 'exclusive', no hype. Tracking notice (teaser and profile form): 'When you sign in, we record which documents you open or download and how long you spend on each page, so the team can follow up with the right information. See our Privacy Policy (/privacy). Ask privacy@automatos.app to see or delete your data.' All UI strings in investors/src/strings.ts.

CODE RULES. Immutability (new objects, never mutate inputs). Files 200-400 lines, never over 800; functions under 50 lines; React components under 150 lines; nesting under 4. zod at every API boundary (server bodies and queries; client parses responses). Errors: the server returns {error:'<code>'} with the right status, logs detail server-side, never leaks stack traces; the client shows a plain message. No console.log in committed code (console.warn/error with context in the server only). Server code is plain ESM JavaScript like server.js, with JSDoc types; the app is TypeScript strict.

EVENTS. Types: signed_in, profile_completed, document_open, document_download, page_view, section_view, video_progress. document_open and document_download are written by the SERVER when it issues a link; the client may send only page_view, section_view, video_progress and heartbeats. duration_ms capped at 600000; page between 1 and the document's page_count (when known) else 1..2000; at most 50 events per batch; body at most 64 kB; 120 requests/minute/investor on /events, 30/minute on /link, 10/minute on PUT /me (express-rate-limit keyed by investor id).

WAVE 2 SCOPE. Build only W2 stories, on top of wave 1 (read wave 1's kit json DONE notes: scripts/ralph/prd-001-portal-w1.json on this branch). In: sections (overview, team, FAQ, contact) with their admin editor, the video player, per-document analytics with page drop-off, CSV export of the investors table, the privacy-policy section, the footer link. Not in: a sitemap entry (the app is noindex until Gerard decides PRD Q7), investor update emails, anything for sensitive documents (PRD Q1).

ONE PUSH, ONE PR, ONE CI RUN. Story commits end ' [skip ci]' and are never pushed by you (the runner pushes the branch as a backup). No story waits on CI and no AC says 'CI green'. When every W2 story passes, the last session runs the gate (--no-ci), then makes ONE empty signed commit without [skip ci]; the runner opens the wave's draft PR and that PR's run is the wave's CI. UI stories are verified by typecheck, lint, unit tests and, at the end, the Playwright screenshots of W2-09 in CI (no local browser: KP6).

STACKED ON WAVE 1. The branch is cut from origin/feat/investor-portal-1 (or origin/main once wave 1 merged). Never edit a wave-1 file except where a story names it; a wave-1 defect you hit is fixed only if the story cannot be built without it, recorded as 'W1 FIX: <path> — <why>' in the DONE note, with a test. Wave 1's tests must keep passing unchanged.

localChecks: npm test (root: vitest run over server/investors/**/__tests__)
references: The private PRD (path above): sections 4 to 12 are the spec this kit implements; section 6 is the data model, section 7 the API.

Academy (READ ONLY, via git -C $RALPH_ACADEMY_REPO show origin/main:<path>): server/spine/auth.js (Clerk verifier, authorized parties, injectable middleware), server/media/s3.js (lazy S3 client, presigned PUT), server/media/index.js and server/content/index.js (admin allowlist parse, fail-closed config).

This repo: server.js (hydrateConfig, the allow-list static middleware, the contact form's nodemailer transport), _config.js.template, Dockerfile, .dockerignore, index.html (the tokens and fonts KP13 lists), _theme.js (the mood switch).
Wave 1 on this branch: scripts/ralph/prd-001-portal-w1.json (its DONE notes say what exists and where) and its code under server/investors/ and investors/.

ownerTest.what: Before merging: confirm the privacy text's retention period (24 months after the last visit, PRD Q6) or change it.
After deploy: write the team, FAQ and contact sections (with the booking link) in the admin editor and publish them.
Upload the demo video; play it as the test investor; check the investor detail shows 25/50/75/100%.
Read the test deck as two test investors to different depths; check the document stats chart and drop-off line.
Export the investors CSV and open it in a spreadsheet.
The footer link appears on every site page and opens /investors.

userStories.title: Document analytics API
userStories.description: As an admin, I want to see where readers drop off in the deck.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /admin/documents/:id/stats?version (requireAdmin; default the current version): uniqueReaders, opens, downloads, avgTimeMs (per reader, page_view sum), pages [{page, avgDwellMs, readersReached, pctReached}] for 1..page_count (zero-filled), readers [{investorId, name, firm, furthestPage, timeMs, downloaded, lastOpenAt}] ordered by lastOpenAt desc; versions [numbers that have events] → DONE — f4f15c6: route in routes/admin-documents.js (showStats), shape in queries/document-stats.js documentStats(); admin-document-stats.test.js asserts every field for v2 and v1 of a five-page deck

Computed in SQL (generate_series for pages); a document without page_count returns pages [] → DONE — f4f15c6: SUMMARY_SQL, PAGES_SQL (generate_series(1, d.page_count), LATERAL dwell and reach), READERS_SQL, VERSIONS_SQL; test: a document with pageCount null answers pages []

Tests (PGlite with fixture events across two versions): version filter, zero-filled pages, pctReached monotonic non-increasing, reader ordering, non-admin 403 → DONE — f4f15c6: 13 tests in server/investors/__tests__/admin-document-stats.test.js (version filter, zero-filled pages, pctReached non-increasing and rounded 33.3, reader ordering, 403 non-admin, plus 400/404/401/503)
npm test passes → DONE — npm test: 20 files, 502 tests passed
userStories.notes: | DONE (f4f15c6): no packages added. GET /admin/documents/:id/stats?version answers {document (toDocument), version (the one answered; default the current), versions (numbers with events, NEWEST FIRST: the current version may be missing when unread, so the picker should add document.version), uniqueReaders, opens, downloads, avgTimeMs, pages [{page, avgDwellMs, readersReached, pctReached}], readers [{investorId, name, firm, furthestPage, timeMs, downloaded, lastOpenAt}]}. Rules W2-06 must label: a reader is any investor with an event of that version (open, download, page_view, video_progress), so download-only readers and opens with no page recorded count with furthestPage 0 (page 1 is rarely 100%); avgTimeMs averages page_view time over every reader; avgDwellMs averages each reader total on that page over the readers who viewed it; pctReached is 0..100 with one decimal (0 when no readers); readers order: lastOpenAt desc, lastOpenAt null (download only) last; pages is [] when pageCount is null (video and other kinds: the empty state); older versions are charted over the CURRENT page_count, their furthestPage uncapped. ?version is a whole number 1..2147483647 (MAX_VERSION in queries/document-stats.js) else 400 invalid {fields:{version:invalid}}; an unknown version answers zeros; 404 not_found for unknown/non-uuid ids; 503 storage_unavailable without S3 (the documents gate). routes/admin-documents.js exports statsQuerySchema and is now 436 lines (was 406). W2-09 e2e: the stats screen calls GET /admin/documents/:id/stats (add it to e2e/fixtures/api.ts).

userStories.title: CSV export of the investors table
userStories.description: As an admin, I want to export the current investor list.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /admin/investors.csv (requireAdmin) with the same q/type/source/sort as the list, all pages, columns as the table plus email and marketing opt-in; Content-Disposition attachment 'investors-YYYY-MM-DD.csv'; every cell escaped (quotes doubled) and cells starting with = + - @ tab or CR prefixed with a single quote (formula injection)
'Export CSV' button on the investors table (fetch with the Bearer token, then save as a Blob; the reference portal's csvExport helper may be ported for the client side only if used)
Tests: server (PGlite): filters honoured, escaping, formula-injection prefix; app: the download helper
npm test and the investors checks pass

userStories.title: Privacy policy section and footer link
userStories.description: As an investor, I want to know what is tracked; as the team, we want the portal easy to find.
acceptanceCriteria:
privacy.html gains ONE section after Section 06 in the same markup:

Section 07Investor portal

with paragraphs covering: what we record (your profile; documents you open or download; time spent on each page; visits), why (to follow up with interested investors; legitimate interest), who sees it (the Automatos team members who run the portal), how long (24 months after your last visit), and how to get a copy or have it deleted (privacy@automatos.app); if the page's aside lists sections, add the entry there too; nothing else on the page changes
_footer.js: the Company column gains { label: 'Investors', href: '/investors' } after 'Contact'; nothing else changes
The app's tracking notice (wave 1) links to /privacy#investors
No sitemap or robots change (KP17)
Gate: the diffs of privacy.html and _footer.js contain only additions
